# Cursor Rules Generator (.mdc)

> The modern, client-side, multi-file rules generator for Cursor AI, Claude Code, and Windsurf.

## Overview
Cursor Rules Generator (https://cursor.pacebowl.com/) is a developer utility designed to generate modular, path-scoped `.cursor/rules/*.mdc` files. It prevents AI context bloat and token waste by scoping development instructions to specific file patterns via glob matching.

## Key Capabilities
- **Modular Multi-file Architecture**: Exports rules to `.cursor/rules/*.mdc` with standard YAML frontmatter (`description`, `globs`, `alwaysApply`).
- **1-Click Zip Export**: Packages the full `.cursor/rules/` directory structure using client-side JSZip.
- **Universal Multi-Target Export**: Generates `.cursor/rules/*.mdc` (Cursor), `CLAUDE.md` (Claude Code), `.windsurfrules` (Windsurf), and legacy `.cursorrules`.
- **Framework Presets**: Production-ready configurations for Next.js 15 (App Router, Server Actions), React 19, Vue 3 / Nuxt, Python FastAPI (Pydantic v2), Golang (Gin/Chi), Node.js, Tailwind CSS v4, Supabase (with RLS), and Zod.
- **Guardrails**: Strict TypeScript, Early Return pattern, error boundary conventions, and zero redundant AI comments.

## Engineering Guides & Tutorials
- [Cursor Rules (.mdc) vs .cursorrules Migration Guide](https://cursor.pacebowl.com/blog/cursor-rules-mdc-vs-cursorrules.html): Explains the technical rationale behind replacing monolithic .cursorrules with path-scoped .mdc files.
- [How to Write Next.js 15 Cursor Rules](https://cursor.pacebowl.com/blog/how-to-write-nextjs-15-cursor-rules.html): Production rules for App Router, React Server Components boundaries, and Server Actions validation.

## Modern .mdc vs Legacy .cursorrules
- **Legacy `.cursorrules`**: Single monolithic file injected into every prompt. Leads to high token usage, context contamination, and conflicting instructions.
- **Modern `.cursor/rules/*.mdc`**: Modular files with YAML frontmatter. Loaded conditionally only when matched by the active file's glob pattern (e.g. `app/**`).

## Usage
1. Open https://cursor.pacebowl.com/
2. Select target frontend, backend, database, and styling presets.
3. Configure code quality guardrails (strict types, early return, error handling).
4. Click "Download .zip" to get the ready-to-use `.cursor/rules/` folder.
5. Extract the archive into your project root.
